description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Get an issue by ID within a workspace.

Supports optional occurrence timestamp slicing via query parameters.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name.
    issue_id: The issue ID.
    include_occurrence_timestamps: Opt-in for occurrence timestamps.
    occurrence_tail: Return N most recent occurrences.
    occurrence_from: Slice from position (1=latest).
    occurrence_to: Slice to position (1=latest).
    occurrence_window_gte: Filter occurrences observed_at >= this datetime.
    occurrence_window_lte: Filter occurrences observed_at <= this datetime.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    The issue details.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if workspace or issue not found.

query.description: Comma-separated occurrence fields to include (e.g. observed_at)
Sort order for occurrences: asc or desc (default desc)

description.content:
Generate intelligent next steps for an issue using sobrain AI service.

This endpoint calls the sobrain service to generate suggested next steps
based on the issue details and optional comment context.

    workspace_name: The workspace name.
    issue_id: The issue ID.
    request_data: Optional request data with comment contents.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.
    sobrain: Sobrain client for AI features.

Returns:
    Generated next steps for the issue.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if workspace or issue not found.
    HTTPException: 503 if sobrain service is unavailable.

request.name: Generate a just-in-time summary for an issue occurrence in a run session

description.content:
Generate a JIT summary for an issue within a specific run session context.

Finds the latest occurrence of the issue, looks up the RunSessionIssueMap
entry for the given run session, builds a payload, and calls Sobrain to
generate a summary. Stores the summary in the occurrence's additional_context.
